title: The AI Navigator
outro_say: That's the AI Navigator. | It explains. You make the decisions.

steps.screen: A card: what the Navigator does
steps.say: The AI Navigator knows the whole app, your watchlist, your Groups, Sets and funnels, and today's Tides.
It slides out from the right edge, on every page, so the page you're working on stays in view.
Ask anything in your own words. | Here: how do I find coins that are dipping inside an uptrend?
It answers from the app's own readings and help, never from guesses about prices.
The answer walks you through it, step by step. | It points to the right place, and the right training video.
You can also paste a screenshot, and ask what you're looking at.
Close it with the same handle. | The conversation is kept for when you come back.
